sb_prompt: WHAT KIND OF DINING OUT DO YOU ENJOY? WHAT THINGS DO YOU LOOK FOR IN A RESTAURANT THAT WOULD GET YOU TO GO BACK AGAIN?  SEE WHETHER THE OTHER CALLER'S PREFERENCES ARE SIMILAR TO YOURS.
turns: Yeah, I'm actually pretty skeptical about all the hype these days, honestly. It's just not like what it used to be for us regular folks.

Yeah, I totally get that. When I first started out as an adjuster, I thought every place was some high-end spot too, but looking back, I realized I probably just missed out on the real food places anyway.

That's fair, though I think it's just that most places now are all about the show and not the food. Like that diner down on 4th, I've been there maybe a dozen times and the meatloaf is still the best thing I ever ate.

Yeah, I've got that feeling too. Like, the best place I ever ate was this tiny spot in the suburbs nobody's heard of. Just simple stuff, really. No fancy menu, just a guy making great steaks and grilled cheese. I actually went there last week and didn't tell anyone.
Yeah, that's the thing, you never have to worry about wasting your lunch break on some overpriced salad just to look like you're trying.
Right, exactly. It's about getting full on thirty bucks and not having to act like anything.
Yeah, it's a total relief to just sit back and eat without feeling like you're performing.
Yeah, that's the best part, nobody's waiting on you to check your watch.
Yeah, exactly, nobody's making you feel small just because you're eating with a hammer on your wrist.
Yeah, nothing says dining out like a good slice of pie and no one asking you about your credit score.
Yeah, I remember one time I sat there and the waiter kept asking if I needed more water even though I'd just finished a glass.
Yeah, it's just annoying when they act like you're some stranger in a fancy suit instead of a regular guy.
Yeah, plus nobody cares if you just want a sandwich and a beer without worrying about what they think you're ordering.
Yeah, I'm pretty much the same. I'll just grab a burger and a coke and not worry about what they think of me.
Yeah, that's the only way to do it, keep it simple.
Yeah, me too, I usually just head down to the old place on Elm and hit the same burger spot every time.
Yeah, that's where I usually head when I just want something quick and honest.
Yeah, that place is pretty much the same for me.
Yeah, same thing, just a good burger and a cold drink, that's all I need.
Yeah, I think that's about it for me.
Yeah, same here, just a simple meal is best.
Yeah, I guess I'll head out now, thanks for listening.
Yeah, you too, have a good one.
